protocol_description: Verbatim copy of the pinned SCiEL example `examples/mlx_metal_kernel_opt` (commit da80706f98f9); the evaluator, seed program and configuration are the upstream files. README.upstream.md is the upstream README when one exists.
name: SCiEL: MLX Metal GQA attention kernel for Qwen3-0.6B
description: Evolve a custom Metal kernel (CustomGQAAttention) for grouped-query attention in Qwen3-0.6B-bf16 on Apple Silicon. The pinned evaluator validates the kernel, checks bfloat16 correctness against MLX's scaled_dot_product_attention and benchmarks decode/prefill throughput through mlx_lm.generate in a subprocess hook; final_score is a safety-adjusted performance score.

sources.locator: evaluate and helper functions at immutable commit

limitations: Source-inspected SCiEL example; not a reproduced paper result.
The original evaluator and baseline are fetched at the immutable source commit; no upstream implementation is silently repaired.
Hardware-specific: results depend on the Apple GPU generation, MLX version and thermal state; the source README reports the best evolved kernel was slower than the MLX baseline.
